profile.title: DevOps Engineer
profile.description:
My name is Mikhail.
I am studying Robotics at the Technical University of Würzburg-Schweinfurt in Germany.
At the same time, I am mastering the profession of a DevOps engineer.

contactCta.text: Interested? Feel free to contact me via email or LinkedIn, I'll be glad to respond to your offer.

aboutMe.description:
Aspiring DevOps engineer and robotics student with a deep interest in automation and cloud technologies.
I am proficient with Docker, Terraform, Ansible, the basics of orchestration with Docker Compose, and artifact management with Artifactory. Within academic projects, I have deployed and managed infrastructures in AWS and Yandex Cloud, and also implemented web applications based on them.
I am eager to grow in a Junior DevOps Engineer role, solving challenges in building reliable infrastructure and automation.
